title: Writing / Duo / Duo's voice and tone
slide_intent: Set emotional limits around a persistent mascot so reminders remain supportive rather than threatening.
strategic_value: Positive and negative traits paired with product examples can help Duolingo keep Duo recognizable across lessons and notifications.
demonstration: The panel lists what Duo is and is not, followed by preferred and rejected notification and lesson messages.
practical_value: Review mascot copy against both the personality list and the context-specific examples.

content_islands.name: Guidance column
content_islands.spec: Place Duo’s Voice and Tone heading, explanatory copy and text-channel list at left.

content_islands.name: Worked examples
content_islands.spec: Put trait comparisons at the top right, then notification examples and lesson examples below.

reference_purposes.Intent: The source frames Duo as helping people return to learning rather than being hostile.
reference_purposes.Expression: First-person reminders and encouragement demonstrate the mascot’s historical voice.
reference_purposes.Application: Separate notification and lesson examples demonstrate contextual wording.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The historical guidance says Duo communicates through text and excludes threatening, aggressive, violent and mean behavior.

ingredient.name: Duo’s historical voice
ingredient.role: Make persistent encouragement recognizable as the mascot.
ingredient.application: Use supportive and emotive text in lessons, notifications and emails; avoid threats or aggression.
ingredient.scope: Historical official guidelines from the 2024–2025 archived snapshot; this records the displayed guidance, not current Duolingo product behavior. This archived guide does not establish current social-media behavior.
